primary_interest.quote: I saw your note said you want to talk about the Voice API for a contact center overhaul.

use_case.quote: our contact center is basically a legacy PBX setup with a bunch of bolted-on tooling. We want to rebuild it on APIs so my team can own the call flows.

decision_criteria.quote: my default preference is to consolidate with them where I can. Fewer contracts, fewer vendors to manage, one place for billing.

stated_reason.quote: So I'm trying to understand why I'd add another vendor for voice rather than use what they offer.
